title: Skydive Twin Cities LLC
specs: Tandem jump from 13,000 feet with about 60 seconds freefall
Accelerated Freefall solo training program with multiple jump categories
Minimum age 18 with valid photo ID for tandem skydiving
Maximum weight 260 lbs for tandem, 240 lbs for solo training
If over 260 lbs and height/weight not in proportion or unable to lift legs 5-10 seconds, call before booking
Medical conditions require doctor's note clearing skydiving
Proof of health insurance required for solo skydiving
Group discount for tandem skydives: 10 or more people, $20 off per person, all must check in together

blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from 13,000 feet with a trained instructor or learn to skydive solo through an accelerated freefall training program. Video and photo packages of the skydiving experience are available. The dropzone operates seasonally from April through October with specified hours.
